biography.value:
The party may fall through the sand into her burrow while following Zephyr's map. She attacks in defence of three baby Scorpions crawling on her back — she is not evil, she is a mother in her own home. Amira fights alongside the party here.

Stat block (SRD Giant Scorpion)

AC 15 (natural armour). HP 52 (7d10+14). Speed 40 ft. Senses blindsight 60 ft., passive Perception 9. Size Large.

Multiattack. Three attacks: two with its claws and one with its sting.

Claw. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8+2) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). The scorpion has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

Sting. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d10+2) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

Table note: a party that retreats or talks its way past the nest loses nothing but time. Killing the mother leaves three baby Scorpions.
